title: Annotation labels
description: Operator labels for one video or one ordered image sequence: visibility, geometry, instance identity and motion events, in the stored orientation modules receive. A class id has the shape of an identifier. The pinned scenario pack states which ids exist and what each role means. This document is not a score.

label_id.description: Stable name of this label document.

pack_id.description: Scenario pack these class ids are drawn from.

pack_hash.description: Hash of the validated scenario pack. Changing the pack changes this pin.

source_sha256.description: Source identity. A video file uses its file hash, the identity of its first video stream. An ordered image sequence uses the sequence identity of its ordered image hashes.

frame_count.description: Decoded frame count of the source.

width.description: Stored frame width. Display rotation does not swap it.

height.description: Stored frame height. Display rotation does not swap it.

orientation_degrees.description: Orientation of these coordinates. Modules receive stored pixels at 0 degrees. Any other value is refused.

display_rotation_degrees.description: Display rotation recorded on the source. It is not a coordinate transform.

instances.description: Each object the annotator marked, with a stable instance id.

motion_events.description: Onset events. Empty when the annotator recorded none.

x-rules.pack: pack_id and pack_hash match the pack file the command loads.
x-rules.space: orientation_degrees is the stored orientation, 0. display_rotation_degrees, source_sha256, width, height and frame_count match the video. A label in any other orientation is refused. Display rotation is not applied to the pixels.
x-rules.class-role: class_id is in the pack. A scoring class has a null mark. A distractor class is marked distractor or unknown. An ignore class is marked ignore_region or unknown. distractor and ignore_region are not interchangeable.
x-rules.frames: Instance ids are unique. Each instance labels a frame index once, and the index is inside the source.
x-rules.geometry: A box or point lies inside the stored frame. A box is the visible extent, so only a visible or partially_occluded frame may carry one. An amodal box is a separate estimate and is never copied from the visible box. A point without plausible_extent_px is withheld from the primary localization score.
x-rules.events: A motion event names an instance and a labeled onset frame, and its visibility is that frame's visibility. reentry is true only when that frame is visible or partially_occluded.
x-rules.disposition: identity_ambiguous, unknown visibility, unlocalizable geometry and an unknown mark are unscorable. fully_occluded, out_of_view, absent, an ignore region and a point with no plausible extent are not localization denominators. None of these is a numeric score.

box.description: A half-open box, top-left x and y, in stored pixels.

width.description: Width. The right edge x + width is exclusive.

height.description: Height. The bottom edge y + height is exclusive.

geometry.description: How this frame localizes the instance.

oneOf.description: A box over the visible extent, plus an optional distinct amodal estimate.

kind.description: A box over the visible extent.

amodal_box.description: Amodal estimate. Null means the annotator stated none. It is never copied from the visible box.

x.description: Left edge of the amodal estimate.

y.description: Top edge of the amodal estimate.

plausible_extent_px.description: A box has no plausible extent.

oneOf.description: A point. The plausible extent is required before the frame can enter the primary localization score.

plausible_extent_px.description: Reviewed maximum plausible target extent. Null withholds the frame from the primary localization score.

oneOf.description: Uncertainty too large for a meaningful location, or no visible extent.

frame.description: One instance in one stored frame.

frame_index.description: Zero-based index in the decoded source.

visibility.description: Visibility of this instance in this frame.

instance.description: One object. Its id is stable. Its class id is interpreted by the pinned pack.

instance_id.description: Stable instance id. Distinct from a class id and a track id.

class_id.description: Class id. The contract states the shape. The pack states the values and the role.

identity.description: reviewed is an unambiguous instance. identity_ambiguous is unscorable.

non_scoring_mark.description: Null for a scoring class. Otherwise distractor, ignore_region or unknown. These marks are not equated. unknown is unscorable.

frames.description: The frames on which this instance was marked.

motion-event.description: One onset. Image-plane displacement is not an activity state.

instance_id.description: The instance this event belongs to.

onset_frame.description: Frame of the onset. The instance has a label on this frame.

onset_uncertainty_frames.description: How many frames the onset time may move either way.

visibility.description: Target visibility at the onset. It matches the labeled frame.

selection_quality.description: Whether the event selection was settled. uncertain stays recorded.

reentry.description: True when this onset is a re-entry. The frame is then visible or partially occluded.
